headline: What to Do Immediately After a Car Accident in San Diego?
articleBody:
It's easy to feel overwhelmed after a car accident, especially in a busy place like San Diego. But taking the right steps immediately can make a huge difference in your well-being and any potential legal claims down the road. You've got this, and knowing what to do can help calm some of that initial chaos.

First off, check for injuries. Your safety and the safety of others is always the priority. If anyone is hurt, get medical help right away. Even if you feel okay, it's smart to get checked out by a doctor soon after. Then, move to a safe location if your vehicle is still operational and it's safe to do so. If not, stay put and wait for emergency services. Be sure to call the police and report the accident, even if it seems minor. A police report can be incredibly helpful later on, providing an official record of the incident. Exchange information with the other driver(s), including names, contact details, insurance information, and license plate numbers. Don't admit fault or discuss the accident details with anyone other than the police and your attorney.

Next, document everything you can. Use your phone to take pictures of the accident scene, vehicle damage, road conditions, traffic signs, and any visible injuries. Talk to any witnesses and get their contact information. All these details paint a clearer picture of what happened. Finally, don't delay in seeking legal advice. An experienced San Diego car accident attorney, like Brett Peterson, can help guide you through the process, especially when dealing with insurance companies who often try to minimize your claim. They can make sure your rights are protected and you pursue the full compensation you deserve.
